evidence_slice: Ordnance Survey's official OS OpenMap–Local documentation describes an OpenData street-level vector/raster product containing important buildings and generalised building geometries derived from OS MasterMap, and states that sample data can be visualised for Exeter through the OS MasterMap Product Viewer. In the selected public documentation window, no individual Exeter building feature is exposed with polygon coordinates plus record-bound name/classification/type-use attributes. This is source-area/product metadata only; no building footprint was inferred or fabricated.

field_evidence.footprint: Official documentation states OS OpenMap–Local contains generalised building geometries and offers an Exeter sample, but the selected page exposes no individual Exeter building polygon coordinate payload.
field_evidence.identity: The selected source window is product/sample-area metadata only; it exposes no stable record-level Exeter building feature identifier.
field_evidence.type_use: Official documentation states the product contains important buildings, but the selected page exposes no record-bound Exeter building name/classification/type-use attributes.

license: OS OpenData product; exact licence text not exposed in the selected page window
